instruction: Create a summary document named "summary.docx" on Desktop containing the text from both the first and last slides of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting text from first and last slides to a summary document. Evaluator checks if key phrases from slide 1 ('Unlocking the Power of ChatGPT', 'chat.openai.com') and slide 28 ('Break Out Time', 'Share your screen') are present. Verified by analyzing PPTX: slide 1 contains title and URL, slide 28 contains breakout instructions.

Getter logic is correct: properly extracts all text from docx file using python-docx, handles file retrieval from VM, and returns keyword presence dictionary

Data flow is correct: Getter extracts text and checks keyword presence → Metric receives result dict and validates all keywords present → Returns 1.0 if complete, 0.0 otherwise
